name: memvara
description: Bitemporal memory for agents: hosted MCP plus the skill that says how to use it.

interface.shortDescription: Hosted memory for Codex and ChatGPT
interface.longDescription: Fourteen memory tools on a hosted store, plus the skill for using them without forging history, and hooks that recall on every prompt and capture when a turn ends. OAuth in the browser. Runs python3 locally; hooks must be trusted first.
